checks.syntax: AST parsing of changed Python modules and node --check tests/verify_learning_generation.cjs passed.
checks.visual_review: Inspected light/dark 1440px screenshots; interruption explanation, Agent revision, unavailable-source warning and recovery controls are readable.

behavior.projection: Unfinished expired requests read as INTERRUPTED without changing the stored GENERATING record or calling a model.
behavior.completion_fence: Success and failure both require the original private owner and deadline, GENERATING state, revision 1 and an unexpired deadline.
behavior.retry: The original request returns its original status; an explicit new generation creates a new request and retains the interrupted record.
behavior.form_recovery: Restore original instruction, original available sources and modeling mode; identify Agent version or availability changes; reset model consent.
behavior.backup: Refuse live learning generation; clear pending owner and deadline in restored copies only; preserve completed results.

limitations: Restart alone does not mark a request interrupted; the read projection changes only after its processing deadline.
Legacy unfinished rows without a claim use created_at plus 240 seconds for display. Completion fencing applies to this new code, not independently running older binaries.
Refresh recovery uses persisted history or existing request lookup; this change does not add browser storage for an undelivered request or alter the initial in-flight generation close rules.
No external model was invoked; tests use disposable data and offline or synthetic generation.
No release package was built or deployed.
